scope: Independent static producer review, independent analytic/numerical validation of its existing outputs, byte comparison of existing two-runtime outputs, and direct visual inspection of both final synthetic PNGs. No producer execution, source-simulation reproduction, Git or external mutation was performed by this review.
review_type: Independent internal review; not external human peer review

independent_output_validation.method: Independent exact Fraction identities, 80-digit closed LambertW roots, direct finite Fourier Poisson inner products and CSV/JSON checks; producer never imported or executed.

static_review.source_energy_identity: Passed only under the declared periodic continuum self-adjoint Poisson initialization assumptions. It is not a measurement of released-run power.
static_review.self_collision_scope: Self-only frequencies and cumulative exposures are not equated to electron-ion drag or demonstrated changes in published curves.

visual_review.fonts: Current final font sizes are readable; producer declares base 14 pt, ticks 12 pt, legends 11.5 pt.
visual_review.earlier_minor_E12_marker_legend_overlap: Resolved by moving the threshold-panel legend to the lower right. The black reported-E12 marker is now unobscured.

findings_limitations: Printed algebra and conditional normalization findings do not establish that the source authors used those expressions in simulation analysis.
The variance-one plasma-dispersion-function convention exactly rescues the apparent thermal sqrt(2) discrepancy; it is not an unconditional error.
E11 is retained as a positive bridge from correctly integrated growth. Literal E12 inconsistency is distinct from a universal revised nonlinear threshold.
Released inputs and historical solver inspection do not establish the exact executed binary or output behavior.
No source simulations, source raw output, actual injected source power, nonlinear saturation or ion heating were reproduced.
